skill.summary: Use this skill when users need to search the web for information, news, images, or videos. Triggers include: requests to "search for", "find information about", "look up", "what's the latest on", or any request requiring current web content. Also use for research tasks, fact-checking, finding visual resources, or gathering recent news. Requires OpenClawCLI installation from clawhub.ai. Do NOT use when Claude's built-in web_search tool is more appropriate for simple queries.
